description: This file defines an abstract class BaseMockDevice implementing the MockDevice interface. It provides basic device properties such as name, UUID, and online status, and methods to access and modify these properties.

classes.name: BaseMockDevice
classes.description: An abstract class representing a mock device with basic properties such as name, UUID, and online status, implementing the MockDevice interface.

methods.name: BaseMockDevice
methods.description: Constructor initializing the device with a name and UUID.

methods.name: getUUID
methods.description: Returns the UUID of the device.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the device.

methods.name: isOnline
methods.description: Checks if the device is online.

methods.name: setOnline
methods.description: Sets the online status of the device.
